name: get_question_answer
description: Collect the user's answer to a question you asked with ask_user_question when that call returned pending: true because the user had not answered yet. Waits for the answer, up to this call's limit, and returns it. If the user still has not answered, it returns pending: true again: call it again with the same question_id. Do not ask the question again, and do not message the user while you wait.

question_id.description: The question_id from the pending ask_user_question result.

name: image_generate
description: Generate an image, or edit and restyle existing images given as reference_images, with the image service the user configured in Codeg, and save it as a file. Use it when the task needs a raster image (an illustration, photo, icon, texture, banner, mockup); draw things better made in code (SVG icons, charts, CSS) in code instead. Write a detailed prompt: the subject, style, composition, colors, lighting, and any text to render, quoted exactly. The image is written to output_path when you give one (a relative path is resolved against the session's working directory; a directory, or a path without an extension, gets a generated file name; an existing file is replaced). Without output_path it goes to Codeg's image folder: copy or move it into the project yourself if it belongs there. Generating takes from a few seconds to a couple of minutes. If it is not done when this call returns, the result says so and gives a job_id: call image_get_result with it to wait, and do not start the same image again. A finished result gives the saved file's absolute path and pixel size, and a small preview of the image when the user allows it.

prompt.description: What to draw, or what to change in the reference images.

model.description: Model to use. Omit to use the user's default.

aspect_ratio.description: Shape of the image. Omit for the service default (usually square).

resolution.description: Size class of the longer edge. Omit for about 1K. Larger is slower and costs more.

size.description: Exact WIDTHxHEIGHT in pixels, for GPT image models (for example 1536x1024). Takes precedence over aspect_ratio and resolution where the model accepts it.

quality.description: Rendering quality, for models that support it (GPT image models). Lower is faster and cheaper.

background.description: transparent needs a model that supports it (GPT image models) and a .png or .webp output_path.

reference_images.description: Local image files (absolute, or relative to the working directory) to edit, or to use as references. Say in the prompt what to do with them.

output_path.description: Where to save the image. The extension (.png, .jpg, .webp) picks the format.

name: image_get_result
description: Wait for images started by image_generate and collect them, by job_id. Returns as soon as one of them finishes, or when this call's wait ends; call again with the ones still running. A finished job gives the saved file's absolute path and pixel size, and a small preview of the image when the user allows it. While you are only waiting, do not message the user about it; just call again.
